text:
alex: Quick RFC follow-up — proposal to consolidate per-panel RBAC checks into a single query-adapter sidecar to avoid N^2 external lookups when rendering dashboard with many panels.

maria_s: Can you sketch the flow? i'm worried about cache invalidation and tenant isolation.

alex: sketch: panels call console -> query-adapter sidecar -> model/metric backend. sidecar returns per-panel filter/allowed-rows. single auth lookup per panel-group instead of per-panel-per-metric.

samir: main tradeoff is extra network hop + potential single point for auth SLO. how does this affect cold-start latency for first dashboard load? :thinking:

kevin_ops: we can keep local LRU with short TTL (30s) and async refresh to avoid blocking. fallback can call legacy direct auth if sidecar times out.

irene: also need strong tenant boundaries. sidecar must enforce request-scoped tokens and not cache cross-tenant results.

alex: agreed. lightweight response shape (proto/http) e.g.
```
HTTP 200
{
  "panel_id": "p-123",
  "allowed_filter": "tenant_id = 't-9' AND region IN ('us','eu')",
  "cache_ttl": 30
}
```

maria_s: what about rollouts? I'd like an A/B toggle so small % of traffic uses sidecar behind feature flag before wide rollout.

deploy-bot: canary flag created: console.sidecar_auth.enabled = 0.05

samir: ops question — how to monitor degraded cases? metric ideas: sidecar_latency_p50/p99, sidecar_cache_miss_rate, auth_fallback_rate.

kevin_ops: add synthetic warmup on instance startup to pre-populate cache for popular boards.

alex: next steps: write a lightweight RFC with interface contract + security checklist + canary plan. volunteers: alex + maria_s to draft, samir to own SLOs, kevin_ops on ops runbook, irene for tenant-security review. timeline: draft by EOW.

maria_s: +1, will start the draft. :thumbsup:

irene: also schedule a short design review next Tue.

alex: thanks — i'll open the RFC and ping reviewers.
